normalized_records.question: Return the four most frequent labels in CTU scenario 5 with counts; break count ties by label ascending.
normalized_records.final_sql:
SELECT nf.label, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM network_flows nf
JOIN dataset_provenance dp ON nf.source_dataset = dp.dataset_id
WHERE dp.source_name ILIKE '%CTU%' AND dp.dataset_id ILIKE '%5%'
GROUP BY nf.label
ORDER BY count DESC, nf.label ASC
LIMIT 4;

For each source dataset, return the fraction of flows with zero outbound bytes; include NULL byte values in the flow denominator and order by dataset.
normalized_records.final_sql:
SELECT dp.dataset_id AS dataset,
       CASE WHEN nf.cnt IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE CAST(nf.n_zero AS DOUBLE) / nf.cnt END AS fraction_zero_outbound
FROM dataset_provenance dp
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT source_dataset,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt,
         SUM(CASE WHEN bytes_out = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_zero
  FROM network_flows
  GROUP BY source_dataset
) nf ON dp.dataset_id = nf.source_dataset
ORDER BY dataset;
